title: When Alligator Meets Ostrich
description:
In 1907, Los Angeles had both an alligator farm and ostrich farm near present-day Lincoln Park. Exotic animals were displayed as attractions and spectacle. Both parks also featured gift shops selling alligator bags and lamps, ostrich hats and boas.

When Alligator Meets Ostrich draws from these early Los Angeles attractions and from supernatural stories about alligators living in the city’s drainage system.

The performance uses an overhead projector and the visual conventions of silent film. Drawn images are manipulated live to tell an imagined story of an alligator and an ostrich's friendship. Their encounter moves between attraction and escape, climaxing with the arrival of the 1938 Los Angeles flood.
